review_text: Absolutely fantastic service from start to finish! The team turned up on time, worked quickly and left everything spotless. Can't recommend them enough.
Mike went above and beyond fixing our issue same-day. Genuinely impressed - will be using again.
Turned up almost an hour late with no call to say they were running behind. Work itself was fine once they got here, but the wait really put me off.
Absolutely furious. They damaged our fence while doing the job and no one has called us back in 4 days despite two emails. Want a refund and the fence fixed. Considering reporting this.
Job was done okay in the end but felt overpriced for what it was, and I had to ask twice about the final cost before getting a straight answer.
Solid work, friendly crew. Only reason it's not 5 stars is they left a bit of mess in the driveway - not a big deal, just worth mentioning.

I'm genuinely concerned - after the job we noticed a strong gas smell near where they'd been working and had to call an emergency plumber ourselves that night. This feels like a safety issue, not just bad service.
Third time using them, always reliable, always on budget. Wouldn't go anywhere else.
